english.title: Keeper / person with information fail to give identity of driver of a vehicle in a restricted area at Stansted Airport
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..)

(A)_[being the keeper of a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..),]_
(B)_[being a person with information as to the identity of the driver of a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..),]_

in a restricted area, namely **(..SPECIFY THE LOCATION..), at Stansted Airport, failed to give such information as to the identity of the driver to a constable or airport official as it was in your power to give and which may lead to the identification of the driver
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 9(5) and 2(3) of the Stansted Airport - London Byelaws, 1996 and section 63 of the Airports Act 1986.
